existing_finding_connections.trace: The frozen identity function hashes group values and start/end float bits into a raw u64 retained on TreeLeaf. Current source introduces TreeShootId, assigns it from source seeds on selected terminal branch segments, retains it on TreeLeaf, uses it in sorting and filtering, and adapts it to Seed for sampling and full-word provenance. The bounded code addresses the prior raw-retention concern along these inspected paths.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: The identity construction changed from a geometry-derived context to a seed-derived context; same geometry or same source seed is not proven to retain the old word or resulting sampled leaves. No RNG, generator, bake, fixture or render ran. All producers/consumers, collision assumptions, cross-host expectations, artifact and behavior policy remain open; the older requested same-word condition is not silently declared met.

existing_finding_connections.trace: Current tree_source_geometry_hash includes branch endpoints/radii and leaf petiole/centre/length/width plus the full shoot identity word through Seed::from_u64/to_u64, addressing the historical float-narrowing concern. It still does not encode leaf right, up or torsion although the current cambered leaf mesh consumes those values and the current tree-card raster path consumes that mesh. Holding the encoded fields fixed while changing a valid orthogonal leaf-right direction gives the same hash input words but different vertex expressions; this is source reasoning, not a computed hash or bake.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: No pair of independently produced supported leaves, changed artifact, actual collision, stale bake, shader output or test result was observed. Do not call the fingerprint a general runtime cache key or assume stale reuse.
